concerns.location: plan.md:Constitution Check / Principle VI; constitution.md:Principle VI
concerns.text: The plan, spec, and constitution remain mutually incompatible as written: Principle VI mandates a structure-aware comparison for EVERY reported evaluation metric, while the plan delivers composition-only metrics (Phase 6, results_composition_only.json) with the structure-aware path deferred (Phase 8, code-path stub only). The plan honestly flags this and requests an amendment, but until the kickback lands, any metrics artifact produced by this plan violates the constitution. The spec/constitution revision must be resolved before task generation, not after.

concerns.location: data-model.md:Metrics JSON ('Per-fold detail included') vs contracts/model_metrics.schema.yaml
concerns.text: data-model.md states the metrics JSON includes 'Per-fold detail', but model_metrics.schema.yaml sets additionalProperties: false at the top level and defines no per-fold field (only *_mean/*_std aggregates). Either add a per-fold block to the schema or remove the claim from data-model.md — as written, a conforming artifact cannot contain per-fold detail.

concerns.location: plan.md:Phase 6 vs Summary ('never reported as study results')
concerns.text: Phase 6 (marked 'gated; fixture run now') trains on tiny_materials.csv and emits data/results_composition_only.json — the same SSoT artifact named for scientific results. The plan promises fixture values are 'used only for software validation, never reported as study results', but does not specify how fixture-run outputs are distinguished (separate path, label field, or overwrite-on-data-arrival). Specify the mechanism so fixture metrics cannot be mistaken for the scientific SSoT artifact.

concerns.location: plan.md:Spec deviations (FR-002, FR-006, FR-007) vs spec.md
concerns.text: Three deliberate deviations from spec FRs (5-feature node list vs FR-002's 4; 5-fold CV means vs FR-006's shared test set; fold-disagreement band vs FR-007's '95% CI') are consistently documented across plan/research/data-model, but the spec text is unchanged. These are cross-doc disagreements that must be resolved by the requested spec revision before tasks are generated against the deviating definitions.
